Weeknight Beef Chilli
Ingredients
4 servings
1 Tbspolive oil
2onions
large, halved and sliced
3garlic cloves
large, chopped
2 Tbspmild chilli powder
2 tspground cumin
750glean minced beef
400gcan chopped tomato
2beef stock cubes
any brand is fine
2red peppers
large, deseeded and cut into chunks
2 x 400gcans red kidney beans
drained
Instructions
Heat the oil in a large pan and soften the onions for 10 minutes.
Add the beef and brown it, then stir in everything else and simmer for 1 hour.
